senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (मन्यते) (उ,) मनु r. 8th cl. (मनुते)
1 To know, to understand.
2 To regard, to mind.
3 To think, to conceive.
r. 10th cl. (मानयते)
1 To be dull or insensible.
2 To be proud.
3 To oppose, to stop.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (मनति मानयति)
To honour, to respect, to worship.
With अनु prefixed,
To assent to, to agree.
With अभि,
To desire.
With अव,
To disrespect.
With सम,
To concur, to agree.

n. (-नं)
Indian spikenard.
E.
मन to respect, aff. अच्.

r. 1st cl. (मीमांसते)
To investigate, to seek or desire knowledge.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (मानति मानयति)
To respect, to revere, to worship.
With अप or अव prefixed,
to treat with disrespect.

n. (-नं)
1 Measure in general, whether of weight, length, or capacity.
2 A measure, the fourth or eighth part of a khāri.
3 The computation of the duration of a year, solar, lunar, sydereal, &c.
m. (-नः)
1 Arrogance, haughtiness, pride. []
2 Female arrogance or indignation.
3 Taking, seizing.
4 A blockhead.
5 An agent.
6 A barbarian.
E.
मा to measure, ल्युट् aff., or मन to revere, (one's self,) aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Pleasing, agreeable, beautiful.
E.
मनस् the mind, आप to go or attract, aff. अच्; the final consonant of the first word is rejected, and the vowels do not coalesce.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Attended to, applying the mind.
E.
मनस्, and कृत made.

mf. (-लः-ला)
Red arsenic.
E.
मनस् the mind, शिला a stone; a mineral delightful to the mind or heart; also with the dental स, मनःसिल.

mf. (-लः-ला)
Red arsenic: see the last.

n. (-नं)
Minding, understanding.
E.
मन to know, aff, ल्युट्.

n. (-नः)
1 The mind, or considered as the seat of perception and passion, the heart.
2 The intellect, the understanding.
E.
मन to know, to understand, aff. असुन्.

f. (-सा)
The goddess of the serpent race, and the particular protectress against their venom.
E.
मनस् the mind, aff. ठाप्; the object of love and devotion.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Mental.
n. (-सं)
1 The mind, the seat or faculty of reason, and feeling.
2 The lake Mānas, or Mānasarovara in the Himālaya mountains.
3 (In law,) Tacit or implied consent.
f. (-सी)
A goddess peculiar to the Jainas.
E.
मनस् the mind, aff. अण्, or मनस् BRAHMĀ, the supreme mind, अण् aff. of derivation, &c.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Knowing by the mind, perceiving intellectually.
E.
मनसा third case of मबस्, and ज्ञायिन् who knows.

f. (-वी)
The goddess presiding over snakes: see the last.
E.
मनसा the same, and देवी goddess.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Mental, intellectual.
m. (-जः)
A name of KĀMA or love.
E.
मनसि in the heart or mind, and ज born.

m. (-यः)
KĀMA or love.
E.
मनसि in the heart or mind, and शय who reposes.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Mental.
E.
मनस्, and कन् aff.

m. (-रः)
The attention of the mind to its own sensations, consciousness of pleasure or pain.
E.
मनस् of the mind, and कार operation; the compound also occurs with the seventh case सनसिकार.

m. (-पः)
Mental distress.
E.
मनस्, and ताप sorrow.

m. (-लः)
The lion of DURGĀ.
E.
मनस् the mind, तल to depress, aff. घञ्.

f. (-ता)
1 Hope, expectation, dependance.
2 Intelligence.
E.
मनस्विन्, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
1 Attentive, fixing the mind upon any thing.
2 Intelligent, intellectual.
f. (-स्विनी)
A virtuous wife.
E.
मनस् the mind or heart, aff. विन्.

ind.
1 A little.
2 Tardily, slowly.
E.
मन to know, आक् aff.

f. (-का)
A female elephant.
E.
मन to mind or know, Uṇādi aff. आक.

n. (-कं)
A plant, of which the root is sometimes eaten, (Arum indicum.)
f. (-निका)
The fourth or eighth part of a khāri.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Doing little, lazy, sluggish.
f. (-रा)
A sort of Agallochum.
E.
मनाक् a little, and कर who does.

f. (-यी)
The wife of MANU.
E.
मनु the saint, ङीष् aff., and उ changed to ऐ; otherwise मनवी the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Known, understood.
E.
मन to know, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
Pride, dignity.
E.
मानिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, मानित्वं.

n. (-कं)
Collyrium, powdered antimony or other substances, used as an application and ornament to the eye.
E.
मन to know, to be agreeable, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-षा)
Intellect, understanding.
E.
मनस् mind, ईष to go, aff. क, or ईष aff., form irr.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Intellectual, intelligent.
m. (-षी)
A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher.
E.
मनीषा understanding, इनि possessive aff.

m. (-नुः)
1 MANU, the legislator and saint, the son of BRAHMĀ, or a personification of BRAHMĀ himself, the creator of the world, and progenitor of mankind; the name is however a generic term, and in every Kalpa or interval from creation to creation, there are fourteen successive MANUS presiding over the universe for the period of a Manvantara, respectively: in the present creation there have been the six following MANUS: MANU called also SVAYAMBHUVA, the supposed revealer of the code of law possessed by the Hindus, SVAROCIṢA, UTTAMA, TĀMASA, RAIVATA, and CĀKṢUṢA; the seventh or the present MANU is VAIVASVATA, or RAIVATA the second.
2 A man in general.
3 One of the Jaina saints.
4 A Mantra, a mystical verse or formula.
f. (-नुः-नायी-नावी)
The wife of the legislator MANU.
E.
मन to know or understand, (the Vedas or scripture especially,) and उ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-जः)
A man in general.
f. (-जा)
A woman.
E.
मनु the legislator and progenitor of mankind, and ज born, descended.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A king.
E.
मनुज, and इन्द्र chief.

m. (-भूः)
Man, a man, mankind.
E.
मनु the saint, and भू born: see the last.

m. (-राट्)
KUVERA, the god of wealth.
E.
मनु man, and राज् to shine, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-षी)
A woman, the wife or female of the man.
E.
मनुष्य a man, and ङीष् aff.

m. (-ष्यः)
Man, a man, mankind.
E.
मनु the progenitor of mankind, यत् aff. of descent, and युक् augment.

n. (-ष्यं)
Manhood, manliness, humanity, the state or quality of a man or mortal.
E.
मनुष a man, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
The state or condition of man, manhood, humanity.
E.
त्व added to मनुष्य; also with तल्, मनुष्यता.

m. (-र्म्मा)
KUVERA, the god of wealth.
n. (-र्म्म)
The duty of man.
E.
मनुष्य man, and धर्म्मन् piety.

m. (-ज्ञः)
Hospitality.
E.
मनुष्य a man, and यज्ञ sacrifice, sacrament.

f. (-भा)
1 A multitude, a crowd, a meeting.
2 A place of meeting or assembly.
E.
मनुष्य a man, mankind, and सभा assembly.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seated in the mind.
n. (-तं)
Thoughts, ideas, notions, feelings.
E.
मनस्, and गत gone to or in.

f. (-वी)
Wish, desire.
E.
मनस् the mind, and गो a cow, &c., fem. form.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Thought or meditated on secretly.
f. (-प्ता)
Red arsenic.
E.
मनस् the mind, and गुप्त cherished.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born or seated in the mind.
m. (-जः)
KĀMA.
E.
मनस्, and ज born.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
Born or seated in the mind.
m. (-न्मा)
KĀMA or CUPID.
E.
मनस् the heart or mind, and जन्मन् birth; also मनोज.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Fatherly, parental.
2 Quick in thought or apprehension.
3 Swift, as thought.
f. (-वा)
A plant: see अग्निजिह्वा.
n. (-वं)
Quickness of thought or apprehension.
E.
मनस् the mind, जु to move, to pervade, aff. अच्, or मनस् compounded with जव speed.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Fatherly.
E.
मनोज desire, love, वस to abide, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Beautiful, handsome, lovely, pleasing, agreeable.
f. (-ज्ञा)
1 Red arsenic.
2 The daughter of a sovereign, a princess.
E.
मनस् the mind or heart, ज्ञा to know, to get, aff. क.

m. (-ण्डः)
Restraint or controul over the mind.
E.
मनस्, and दण्ड castigation.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Chosen, preferred.
E.
मनस्, and नीत taken.

m. (-वः)
KĀMA or CUPID.
E.
मनस् the mind or heart, and भव born.

m. (-भूः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
मनस् the heart, भू born.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Swift, quick, as thought.
E.
मनस्, and यायिन् what goes.

m. (-निः)
The deity KĀMA.
E.
मनस् the heart, and योनि place of production.

m. (-थः)
Wish, desire.
E.
मनस् the heart, and रथ vehicle.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Beautiful, lovely, pleasing.
f. (-मा)
1 A goddess, peculiar to the Bauddhas.
2 A species of the Paṅkti metre.
E.
मनस् the mind, रम to delight, aff. अच्.

n. (-ल्यं)
Fancy, caprice, whim.
E.
मनस्, and लौल्य unsteadiness.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disappointed.
E.
मनस् the mind, हत struck.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Beautiful, lovely, pleasing.
E.
मनस् the mind, हृ to take or steal, aff. अप्.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable, lovely.
E.
मनस् the mind, हृ to steal, aff. णिनि.

f. (-ह्वा)
Red arsenic.
E.
मनस् the mind, and ह्वेञ् to call, to arrest, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be reflected on, to be ascertained or fixed in the mind, to be discussed either mentally or with proper persons.
2 To be thought, believed, conceived, &c.
E.
मन to know, aff. तव्य.

m. (-न्तुः)
1 Fault, offence, transgression.
2 A man, mankind.
3 A king.
f. (-न्तुः)
Understanding, intellect.
E.
मन to know, Uṇādi aff. तु.

m. (-न्ता)
1 A sage, one who is possessed of holy knowledge.
2 An adviser, a counsellor.
E.
मन to know, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.

m. (-न्त्रः)
1 A division of the Vedas; in the first or practical part or Kāṇḍam, it includes prayers and hymns, addressed to particular deities, and used at peculiar sacrifices, &c.; in the Uttara Kāṇḍam, it is applied to addresses to BRAHMĀ or God, and to didactic explanations of his nature and attributes, [] &c.
2 A mystical verse or incantation, (in the Tantras.)
3 A formula sacred to any individual deity, as, Om Viṣṇave nama, Om Śivāya nama, &c.
4 Secret consultation, private advice.
E.
मत्रि to advise or consult privately, aff. अच्.

m. (-कृत्)
A counsellor, a minister.
E.
मन्त्र advice, and कृत् who gives or makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Consecrated by the Mantra.
E.
मन्त्र, and कृत made.

m. (-कः)
Knowledge, science.
E.
मन्त्र advice, गडि to be a part of, aff. वुन्.

f. (-प्तिः)
Secret counsel.
E.
मन्त्र, and गुप्ति concealing.

m. (-ढः)
A spy, a secret emissary or agent.
E.
मन्त्र advice, information, गूढ secret.

m. (-ह्वः)
A name of fire.
E.
मन्त्र prayer, and जिह्वा the tongue.

m. (-ज्ञः)
1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent.
2 A counsellor, an adviser.
3 A priest, a sacred teacher.
E.
मन्त्र advice, &c. and ज्ञ who knows.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Advising, counselling in private.
E.
मत्रि to counsel, युच् aff.

ind.
1 From, with, or by, a Mantra or mystical prayer.
2 Advisedly, deliberately.
E.
मन्त्र, and तसि substituted for the termination of the fourth or fifth cases.

m. (-दः)
A spiritual guide or teacher.
E.
मन्त्र initiatory text, and द who gives.

m. (-र्शी)
A Brahman learned in the Vedas.
E.
मन्त्र, and दर्शिन् who sees.

m. (-तिः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
मन्त्र holy prayer, and दीधिति lustre.

m. (-त्मा)
A name of GARUḌA.
E.
मन्त्र, and पूतात्मन् pure.

n. (-लं)
The object or effect of counsel.
E.
मन्त्र, and फल fruit.

m. (-दः)
Divulging or betraying counsel.
E.
मन्त्र, and भेद breaking.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Counselling, consulting.
E.
मत्रि to advise, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Accompanied with holy texts, (a ceremony.)
2 Entitled to use the Vedas.
3 Initiated.
4 Having or hearing counsel.
E.
मन्त्र, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-विट्-वित्)
1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent.
2 A counsellor.
3 A priest.
4 A Brahman learned in the Vedas.
E.
मन्त्र secret council, &c. and विट् who knows.

mfn. (-स्पृक्)
Obtaining or effecting any thing by means of mystic formulæ or prayers.
E.
मन्त्र a prayer of the Vedas, &c., and स्पृश् to touch, aff. क्विन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Advised, counselled, planned.
E.
मत्रि to consult, aff. क्त.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Property or condition of a counsellor, counsellorship.
E.
मन्त्रिन्, and त्व added.

m. (-न्त्री)
A counsellor or adviser, a king's counsellor or minister.
E.
मचि to advise, इनि aff.

m. (-म्मः)
Advice, direction.
E.
मन्त्र, and उपष्टम्भ stopping.

r. 1st cl. (मन्थति)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To afflict.
3 To suffer pain.
1st and 9th cls. (मन्थति मथ्नाति)
To agitate, to stir, to churn.

m. (-न्थः)
1 A churning. stick.
2 The sun.
3 A dish made of barley meal with ghee and water, a sort of gruel or porridge.
4 A disease of the eyes, cataract or opacity.
5 Rheum, excretion of the eyes.
6 Killing, destroying.
7 Agitating, stirring, churning.
E.
मन्थ to churn, &c., aff. अच्.

n. (-जं)
Butter.
E.
मन्थ churning, and ज produced.

m. (-कः)
A churning-stick.
E.
मन्थ churning, and दण्डक a stick.

n. (-नं)
1 Agitating, stirring, churning.
2 Killing, injuring.
f. (-नी)
A churn.
E.
मन्थ to agitate, &c. aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-नः)
A churning-stick.
E.
मन्थ to agitate, आनच् aff.

f. (-टी)
A churn, a common earthen pot used for the purpose.
E.
मन्थन churning, and घटी a small jar or pitcher.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Slow, lazy, tardy.
2 Large, bulky.
3 Curved, bowed, crooked.
4 Stupid, dull, a fool.
5 Low, vile, little.
6 Low, hollow, (as sound.)
m. (-रः)
1 A soldier marching slowly.
2 A spy, an informer.
3 A treasury, a store, a repertory.
4 Fruit.
5 An obstacle, a hindrance.
6 A churning-stick.
7 Fresh butter.
8 The month Vaiśākha.
9 Passion, wrath.
10 A deer.
11 A fort, a strong-hold.
12 The mountain Mandara.
n. (-रं)
Safflower.
E.
मन्थ to agitate, &c. aff. अरण्.

m. (-रुः)
The wind from a Chowrie or whisk.
E.
मन्थ to agitate, अरुन् aff.

m. (-लः)
The mountain Mandara.
E.
मन्थ a churningstick, and शैल a mountain, being so employed in churning the ocean.

mfn. (-न्थी-न्थिनी-न्थि)
1 Agitating, churning.
2 Paining, afflicting.
f. (-नी)
A churn.
E.
मन्थ to churn, णीनि aff.

m. (-धिः)
Sea of milk.
E.
मन्थ churning, and उदघि a sea.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
1 Slow, tardy.
2 Dull, stupid, heavy.
3 Foolish, a fool.
4 Unlucky.
5 Sick, diseased.
6 Little.
7 Idle, lazy.
8 Drunken, addicted to drunkenness.
9 Vile, wicked.
10 Self-willed.
11 Cold, phlegmatic, apathetic.
12 Low, (as a tone.)
m. (-न्दः)
1 A name of SATURN.
2 A sort of elephant.
3 A name of YAMA.
4 (In astronomy,) Anomaly.
5 A destruction of the universe.
E.
मदि to be lazy, &c. aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Dull, not bright.
E.
मन्द, and कान्त shining.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Going slowly.
E.
मन्द, and गत gone.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Slow moving.
f. (-तिः)
Going slowly.
E.
मन्द, and गति going.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Who or what moves slowly.
n. (-नं)
Moving or going slowly.
E.
मन्द, and गमन going.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going slowly or gently.
m. (-मी)
A soldier marching slowly.
E.
मन्द slow, गम to go, aff. घिनुण्.

f. (-नी)
The wife of SŪRYA.
E.
मन्द SATURN, and जननी mother.

m. (-टः)
The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.)
E.
मदि to please, aff. अटच्.

n. (-नं)
Praise, eulogium.
E.
मदि to be pleased, (by) Uṇādi aff. क्यु.

n. (-लं)
(In astronomy), The anomalistic equation of a planet.
E.
मन्द, and फल product.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Stupid, foolish.
E.
मन्द, and बुद्धि understanding.

मन्दभाग्य.
mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Wretched, unhappy, unfortunate.
E.
मन्द, and भाग्य fate.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Dull, stupid, slow of apprehension.
E.
मन्द, and मति intellect.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Slow, tardy.
E.
मदि to be slow, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Delaying, going tardily.
E.
मदि to be lazy, causal v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Large, bulky.
2 Slow, sluggish, dull, lazy, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 The mountain Mandara, with which the ocean was churned by the Suras and Asuras, after the deluge, for the purpose of recovering the sacred things lost in it during that period.
2 The Mandara tree, one of the trees of paradise.
3 Svarga or the paradise of the Hindus.
4 A string of pearls, &c.
5 A mirror.
E.
मदि to please, to be lazy, &c. अरन् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 One of the five trees of Svarga.
2 The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.)
3 Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.)
E.
मदि to delight, &c. aff. आरक्.

m. (-नः)
1 A name of AGNI or fire.
2 Life, living.
3 Sleep, sleeping.
E.
मदि to be slow or sleepy, Uṇādi aff. असानच्.

n. (-तं)
A smile, a gentle laugh.
E.
मन्द slowly, gently, स्मित smiling.

n. (-स्यं)
A smile, a gentle laugh.
E.
मन्द slowly, gently, and हास्य laughter.

n. (-कः)
Praising, praise.
E.
मन्द to praise, आकन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-नी)
1 The Ganges of heaven.
2 A species of the Jagatī metre.
E.
मन्द slowly, अक to go, aff. णिनि, fem. form.

f. (-न्ता)
A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre.

n. (-क्षं)
Modesty, shame, bashfulness.
E.
मन्द slow, retiring, and अक्ष organ of sense.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Slow of apprehension, dull.
E.
मन्द, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Disregarding, neglecting, disrespecting.
E.

E.
